steps.name: Install production Python 3.14, runtime deps and pinned test tools
argv: apt-get update -qq && apt-get install -y -qq python3-venv && python3 -m venv /tmp/uv-bootstrap && /tmp/uv-bootstrap/bin/pip install --quiet uv==0.10.2 && /tmp/uv-bootstrap/bin/uv venv --python 3.14 .venv && /tmp/uv-bootstrap/bin/uv pip install --python .venv -r requirements.txt pytest==9.1.1 ruff==0.15.21

steps.name: Build the wheel once and record its digest
Install the exact tested wheel cleanly, run the CLI, boot the server
argv: (cd .ci-results/dist && sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS); /tmp/uv-bootstrap/bin/uv venv --python 3.14 /tmp/accept; /tmp/uv-bootstrap/bin/uv pip install --python /tmp/accept .ci-results/dist/*.whl; /tmp/accept/bin/elixis --version; /tmp/accept/bin/elixis --help > /dev/null; .venv/bin/python app.py --port 3110 > /tmp/elixis-server.log 2>&1 & pid=$!; trap 'kill $pid 2>/dev/null' EXIT; for i in $(seq 1 30); do curl -sf -o /dev/null http://127.0.0.1:3110/ && break; sleep 1; done; for path in / /api/health /llms.txt; do code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' http://127.0.0.1:3110$path); echo "$path $code"; test "$code" = 200 || { cat /tmp/elixis-server.log; exit 1; }; done
